title: Minimal Phone 2 – Minimal Company
author: Minimal Company
summary: Product and preorder page for Minimal Phone 2, a compact Android smartphone with a physical keyboard and software designed to reduce distractions. It details Minimal OS, a unified communications hub, configurable usage limits, hardware specifications, and customization options including an unlockable bootloader and a planned official de-Googled ROM. Preorders offer finish, storage, and keyboard choices, with shipping estimated for December 2026.
